summary: North flow over the Alps dominates the week. Monday brings strong easterly wind and a moderate north-foehn index; Tuesday, Thursday and Friday stay calm at take-off but carry north wind of 30–50 km/h at 3000 m over the south face. Wednesday and Saturday are the lightest days: weak thermals, a moderate foehn index on Wednesday and a model split on Saturday. The outlook from 18 Oct stays mixed, with north flow in 20–50 % of ensemble members.

days.headline: Strong ENE wind at launch height in the morning, then north wind 30–38 km/h at 3000 m; moderate north foehn index.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −2.9 hPa (ECMWF, peak −3.2) / −4.0 hPa (ICON, peak −4.6); Zurich−Lugano +3.3 / +4.2 hPa (peaks +5.2 / +5.9): moderate north foehn. North flow aloft at Bassano but air still moist (RH 77–94 %), so no dry lee signature; models agree.
days.text: Morning: ENE wind 29–34 km/h at launch height (~1000 m) and 28–36 km/h at 850 hPa until about 12:00, with modelled plain gusts 48–73 km/h. From midday the low-level wind eases (13–18 km/h at launch by 14–15:00), but the 700 hPa wind turns north and strengthens to 32–38 km/h by mid-afternoon. Cloud cover around 50–75 % low cloud, cloud base ~1200–1500 m; weak thermals (w* up to 1.7 m/s) topping out ~1500–1700 m. Moderate foehn index with northerly flow aloft points to lee turbulence on the south face. Models agree on direction but differ by up to 40 km/h on speed in the morning.
days.main_risk: Strong easterly gusts in the morning, then north wind aloft over the south face (lee, rotor).

days.headline: Calm near the ground but north wind 43–53 km/h at 3000 m all day: south face in the lee of the massif.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −1.4 hPa (ECMWF, peak −2.5) / −2.1 hPa (ICON, peak −2.5); Zurich−Lugano +1.7 / +2.3 hPa: weak north foehn. North flow aloft and slight warming at 850 hPa, but not dry (RH 69–78 %); models agree.
days.text: Mostly clear sky. Launch-height wind light (5–8 km/h, SW) and 850 hPa wind under 10 km/h from the WNW, so take-offs may look calm. Above that, a firm northerly at 700 hPa (≈3000 m) of 43–46 km/h through the day, rising to 50–53 km/h by 16–17:00. Thermals to ~1350–1450 m around midday, w* ~1.5 m/s; modelled plain gusts 30–37 km/h in the afternoon. A calm or light-south launch under such a north flow is not a sign of safe air: lee turbulence and gusts can mix down. Models disagree strongly on the light low-level wind direction.
days.main_risk: North wind above 40 km/h aloft over the south face: lee turbulence and gusts mixing down.

days.headline: Light winds low down, stable warm air and weak thermals; moderate foehn index, north flow aloft easing after midday.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −3.6 hPa (ECMWF, peak −4.7) / −3.0 hPa (ICON, peak −3.5); Zurich−Lugano +1.3 / +3.2 hPa: moderate north foehn. North flow 22–28 km/h at 700 hPa in the morning, RH 50–55 % (not below 40 %), so no full lee signature; capped at marginal.
days.text: Sunny with no low cloud. Launch-height wind very light (2–5 km/h, W/SW); 850 hPa under 10 km/h. In the morning the 700 hPa wind is N at 22–28 km/h, then backs to WNW and drops to 18–20 km/h after 13:00, with its north component under 15 km/h. The air at 850 hPa is warm (12–13 °C), so the day is stable: thermals weak (w* ~1.2 m/s) and topping out only ~1000–1050 m, below the higher take-offs. Modelled gusts 18–26 km/h. The moderate foehn index means the north flow could strengthen or reach lower than modelled. The models disagree widely on the light low-level wind direction.
days.main_risk: Moderate north foehn index: possible lee turbulence if the north flow aloft is stronger than forecast.

days.headline: Calm low down but NNW wind at 3000 m strengthening from 27 to 42 km/h through the day.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −1.6 hPa (ECMWF, peak −1.8) / −2.0 hPa (ICON, peak −2.9); Zurich−Lugano +1.6 / +1.9 hPa: weak north foehn. North flow aloft, not dry (RH ~70 %). ECMWF and ICON disagree on the strength of the gradient.
days.text: Mostly sunny, some mid-level cloud around midday. Launch-height and 850 hPa winds very light (under 10 km/h, variable). At 700 hPa a NNW flow of 27–32 km/h in the morning increases to 36–42 km/h in the afternoon, with its north component above 30 km/h from 13:00. Thermals weak in the morning, reaching ~1300 m around midday with w* ~1.3 m/s; possible cumulus base ~1250–1300 m. Modelled gusts under 21 km/h on the plain. As on Tuesday, light wind at take-off sits under a north flow aloft that puts the south face in the lee. Models disagree widely on the light low-level wind direction.
days.main_risk: Strengthening north flow aloft over the south face in the afternoon.

days.headline: Low cloud and humid air in the morning, NNE wind 29–43 km/h at 3000 m; light E/SE low down.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −1.0 hPa (ECMWF, peak −1.5) / −1.0 hPa (ICON, peak −2.1); Zurich−Lugano +1.2 / 0.0 hPa (peaks +2.2 / +1.0): weak north foehn. North flow aloft but humid air (RH 76–99 %); the two models disagree.
days.text: Grey start with 75–85 % low cloud and a cloud base near 1200–1350 m, slowly breaking to 50–60 % in the afternoon. Launch-height wind light (7–9 km/h, E to SE); 850 hPa under 10 km/h. At 700 hPa a NNE wind of 33–43 km/h in the morning and 29–34 km/h in the afternoon, north component above 30 km/h for most of the day. Thermals weak, to ~1400–1500 m, w* up to 1.4 m/s; cumulus base ~1250–1500 m in the afternoon. Modelled gusts 16–28 km/h. Models differ by up to 29 km/h on speed in the morning and widely on low-level direction later.
days.main_risk: North wind aloft over the south face, plus low cloud on the upper take-offs in the morning.

days.headline: Light winds at all levels, mid-level cloud and weak thermals; foehn index split between models, no north flow at Bassano.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −1.1 hPa (ECMWF, peak −1.6) vs −3.1 hPa (ICON, peak −3.5); Zurich−Lugano +1.4 vs +4.7 hPa (peak +6.9): moderate on ICON, none on ECMWF. No north flow or dry air at Bassano, so no lee signature; class capped at marginal.
days.text: Light winds through the day: launch-height wind 2–4 km/h (NE turning E to ESE in the afternoon), 850 hPa 3–7 km/h from the ENE, 700 hPa under 11 km/h. Modelled gusts under 17 km/h. Some mid-level cloud (20–38 %), no low cloud. Thermals weak, w* ~1.1–1.3 m/s, reaching ~1300 m; cumulus base possibly ~1100–1150 m, below Baita Camol and Panettone. The foehn picture is uncertain: ICON shows a moderate north-foehn gradient across the Alps, ECMWF almost none, and neither shows northerly flow at Grappa. With winds this light, the models disagree widely on direction.
days.main_risk: Models split on the foehn gradient; low cumulus base could cover the higher take-offs.

outlook.text: Mostly light wind (850 hPa median 10 km/h, 700 hPa 17 km/h, 90th pct 38). Rain chance 20 %. North flow in 41 % of members; Bozen−Innsbruck median −2.8 hPa (range −6.5 to +0.7): weak north foehn, with a tail toward strong.
North flow in 51 % of members, 700 hPa median 28 km/h (90th pct 48) from the NNE. Rain chance 21 %. Bozen−Innsbruck median −2.5 hPa (range −5.6 to +1.1): weak north foehn.
850 hPa median 11 km/h, 700 hPa median 24 km/h but 90th pct 55. North flow in 44 % of members; rain chance 15 %. Bozen−Innsbruck median −1.0 hPa (range −5.9 to +2.4): no foehn signal in the median.
Wide spread: 850 hPa median 11 km/h (90th pct 40), 700 hPa median 30 km/h. North flow in 37 % of members, rain chance 22 %. Bozen−Innsbruck median −2.5 hPa (range −6.2 to +2.2): weak north foehn.
850 hPa median 11 km/h (90th pct 40), 700 hPa median 26 km/h. North flow in 35 % of members, rain chance 18 %. Bozen−Innsbruck median −0.4 hPa (range −6.3 to +2.0): no foehn signal in the median.

Easterly tendency at 850 hPa (median 11 km/h), 700 hPa median 24 km/h. North flow in only 19 % of members, rain chance 24 %. Bozen−Innsbruck median +0.5 hPa (range −4.4 to +2.9): no foehn signal.
